dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, you and Ploy did a good job today. Where is she?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, juː ənd ˈplɔɪ ˈdɪd ə ˈɡʊd ˈdʒɑːb təˈdeɪ. ˈwɛr ɪz ʃiː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: She had to go to class. Thank you! We were so nervous.
dialogue.reading: ʃiː ˈhæd tə ˈɡoʊ tə ˈklæs. ˈθæŋk juː! wiː wɜːr soʊ ˈnɜːrvəs.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'd like to do business with you. In fact, I'd like to make an offer.
dialogue.reading: aɪd ˈlaɪk tə ˈduː ˈbɪznəs wɪð juː. ɪn ˈfækt, aɪd ˈlaɪk tə ˈmeɪk ən ˈɔːfər.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'll invest 300,000 baht for 20% of your company.
dialogue.reading: aɪl ɪnˈvɛst ˈθriː ˈhʌndrəd ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt fər ˈtwɛnti pərˈsɛnt əv jʊr ˈkʌmpəni.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's very generous. But could you make it 15%? We'd like to keep more of the company.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈvɛri ˈdʒɛnərəs. bʌt kʊd juː ˈmeɪk ɪt ˌfɪfˈtiːn pərˈsɛnt? wiːd ˈlaɪk tə ˈkiːp ˈmɔːr əv ðə ˈkʌmpəni.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hmm. OK, 15%. But you'll have to send me a report every month.
dialogue.reading: ˈhm. oʊˈkeɪ, ˌfɪfˈtiːn pərˈsɛnt. bʌt juːl ˈhæf tə ˈsɛnd miː ə rɪˈpɔːrt ˈɛvri ˈmʌnθ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Of course. So, do we have a deal?
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. soʊ, duː wiː ˈhæv ə ˈdiːl?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: We do! I'm happy we could make a deal so quickly. I'm sure we'll make money together.
dialogue.reading: wiː ˈduː! aɪm ˈhæpi wiː kʊd ˈmeɪk ə ˈdiːl soʊ ˈkwɪkli. aɪm ˈʃʊr wiːl ˈmeɪk ˈmʌni təˈɡɛðər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you so much! We won't make you regret it.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː soʊ ˈmʌtʃ! wiː ˈwoʊnt ˈmeɪk juː rɪˈɡrɛt ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Just keep doing your best. And don't make any big decisions without telling me.
dialogue.reading: ˈdʒʌst ˈkiːp ˈduːɪŋ jʊr ˈbɛst. ənd ˈdoʊnt ˈmeɪk ˈɛni ˈbɪɡ dɪˈsɪʒənz wɪˈðaʊt ˈtɛlɪŋ miː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: We won't. I can't wait to tell Ploy!
dialogue.reading: wiː ˈwoʊnt. aɪ ˈkænt ˈweɪt tə ˈtɛl ˈplɔɪ!
